label: official-http-control
setup: headscale server_url http://headscale.lab:8080 (non-80 port), client: tailscale up --login-server=http://headscale.lab:8080
findings: With an http:// control URL on a port other than 80, the official client refuses plaintext and dials TLS on 443 instead (log: 'TLS forced: no port 80 dialed').
While resolving the control host, the official client queries bootstrap DNS on *.tailscale.com DERP servers (outbound connections to Tailscale infrastructure).
